scenes.description: A mother prepares breakfast and a lunchbox for her young son, getting him ready for school. On their walk to school, they pass a bakery displaying a decorated cake, and the boy pauses to admire it.

scenes.title: The Bakery Bargain
scenes.description: The mother returns home, handles chores, and interacts with a neighbor. Later, she visits the bakery to check the price of the cake and makes a deal with her son: if he studies hard, she will buy that cake for his birthday.

scenes.title: A Promise Kept
scenes.description: Walking home from school later, the son happily announces that he has told all his friends about the promise, and the mother smiles with pride.
